title: Tables rows columns and types
objective: Rows represent individual facts; columns have enforced PostgreSQL types and nullable constraints. A SELECT list must expose only fields the consumer is authorized to read.
misconception: The starter leaks the users' email field and includes a second tenant.
acceptance: Store a status as boolean instead of inventing text values; enforce tenant filtering in a data access boundary, not only in a UI. Inspect the result view's columns with information_schema to confirm the exact public projection.
securityBoundary: A query can succeed while exposing data from another tenant or leaking email. Testing only SELECT success is insufficient.
